description: Discover Parisian charm in this beautiful 3‑bedroom apartment located in the heart of Le Marais. With a modern equipped kitchen, central air conditioning, and a bright living room with a sofa bed, it can comfortably host up to 8 guests. Just steps away from restaurants, boutiques, and museums, it’s the perfect spot for an unforgettable stay with family or friends.The spaceDiscover this spacious apartment of 130 sqm featuring:* Stylish and refined living room* Convertible sofa bed for two guests* Modern open kitchen fully equipped with dining area* Bedroom 1: king‑size bed with en‑suite bathroom (shower)* Bedroom 2: queen‑size bed* Bedroom 3: queen‑size bed with en‑suite bathroom (shower)* Additional bathroom with bathtub* Two separate WCsGuest accessFull access to the apartment for a fully independent stayOther things to note* 130 sqm (1400 sq.ft)* High-speed Wi-Fi* Elevator access* Central air conditioning* Baby crib provided* Quiet building* Three bedrooms + one sofa bed (8 guests)* Bed linen, towels, and toiletries provided* Private driver / airport transfer on requestPlease contact us for any additional requests.We look forward to hosting you!
